title: SEG Test Outcome Node
description: Schema for a TestOutcome node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Generated entirely by the CI pipeline from twister test runner output. Sourced from repo C. Immutable once created — a new test run produces new nodes; old nodes are retained permanently as historical record. Node hash is computed transiently by the extractor and persisted only in sealed proof documents — not stored in this record.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this test outcome. Form: {namespaceBase}/outcome/{runId}/{testcaseId}. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Action on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable identifier combining run ID and test case ID. Form: {runId}/{testcaseId}.

seg:runId.description: Identifier for the test run that produced this outcome.

seg:specId.description: IRI reference to the TestSpecification node this outcome confirms.

seg:repoBSha.description: Full git SHA of repo B at the time this test was executed. Supports both SHA-1 (40 chars) and SHA-256 (64 chars) git object formats. Conservative binding — covers the full repo. At proof generation time, compared against current repo B HEAD — a mismatch marks this outcome stale.

seg:outcome.description: Test execution result. FAIL, ERROR, and SKIPPED outcomes block proof generation unless excused by a valid non-expired Waiver node.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoC for all TestOutcome nodes.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative path within repo C to the twister log file from which this test outcome was extracted.
